integrity: The infinite result is proved by an exact domination classification and a complete classification of disconnected induced complements of a crown graph. Exhaustive enumeration for n from three through eight independently checks the structural cases, every coefficient, minimum sets, and the total count; the finite computation is not substituted for the proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to connected crown graphs with n at least three and to the convention that the whole vertex set is admissible. It does not cover arbitrary matching deletions from complete bipartite graphs. The finite verifier checks n from three through eight only. A 2007 precursor for the parameter was located with year-level but not exact day-level public date evidence, so the stored exact first-public date is the earliest inspected day-level source.
title: Outer-connected domination polynomial of crown graphs
